calculation.description: At each completed session, rank the 15 tradable benchmark instruments by the negative same-session open-to-close return. Higher values indicate intraday weakness and are expected to predict stronger next-session close-to-close returns. Only completed OHLC data are used.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable across 2020-2022 (IC 0.04811, ICIR 0.14286), 2023-2024 (0.05281, 0.16212), 2025-2026 (0.04898, 0.14479), and the 2027 recent subset (0.04317, 0.13393). The lower date coverage reflects synchronized open/close availability; every usable date has at least 8 names. Correlation audit used overlapping real signal artifacts and the maximum observed absolute correlation was 0.18284.
